subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Name landscape words like river, mountain, lake and island.
Use the adjectives deep, high and wide.
Describe a place with an adjective and a landscape word.

tf.why: Yes! A lake is full of water.

tf.s: A forest has a lot of buildings.
tf.why: A forest has a lot of trees. A city has a lot of buildings.

tf.s: A city has a lot of buildings and a lot of people.
tf.why: Correct! A city is very big.

tf.s: A mountain is easy to climb.
tf.why: A mountain is hard to climb because it's very high.

tf.s: Jabal Shams is a high mountain in Oman.
tf.why: Well done! Jabal Shams is very high.
We say 'a high mountain' and 'a deep lake'.

tf.s: 'Wide' tells us about one side to the other.
tf.why: Great! A wide river is big from side to side.

tf.s: A hill is higher than a mountain.
tf.why: A mountain is higher than a hill.
Yes! Water falls down a waterfall.

tf.s: A city has water all around it.
tf.why: An island has water all around it.

boxes.why: One river, it's there: 'Yes, there is.'

boxes.q: It's hard to climb. It's very high.
Odd one out: river, lake, waterfall, city
boxes.why: A city has no water like the others.

boxes.q: Ask to find a picture with an island.
Which is NOT a landscape word?
Answer: Is there a high mountain? (✗)
boxes.why: One mountain, not there: 'No, there isn't.'

boxes.q: Water moves along it to the sea.

hunt.q: Is there an island? Yes, there...

mcq.q: Which adjective means very tall, like a mountain?
It's got water. It's wide. It isn't a river. It isn't a waterfall. What is it?
It's got a lot of buildings and people. It's very big. What is it?
Complete: The river is very ___ (from one side to the other).
mcq.why: Wide means big from side to side.

mcq.q: Choose the best phrase for Jabal Akhdar.
mcq.why: Jabal Akhdar is a high mountain.

mcq.q: Which is the best riddle for 'forest'?
o: It's got a lot of trees. Animals live there.
It's got water all around it.
It's got a lot of buildings.
It's very deep and has water.
mcq.why: Trees tell us it's a forest.

mcq.q: Which group has water in all of them?
mcq.why: Rivers, lakes and waterfalls all have water.
Lakes are deep; mountains are high.
